data.one_liner: Detect system and third-party VPN connections with native iOS and Android support.
data.what_it_does: Detects active VPN connections using native iOS and Android APIs, including both system-configured VPN profiles and third-party applications like NordVPN or ExpressVPN. It provides one-time checks as well as real-time status streams and protocol details.
use_when: You need to detect if a user is connected to a VPN on iOS, Android, or desktop platforms.
You require real-time updates when a user connects or disconnects from a VPN.
You need detailed information such as the active network interface and VPN protocol.
avoid_when: You need to run VPN detection inside a web browser.
You require 100% precision on desktop operating systems where fallback heuristics are used.
strengths: Detects both system-configured VPNs and third-party apps with high accuracy on mobile.
Provides a real-time status stream alongside one-time check methods.
App Store safe without requiring restricted entitlements.
weaknesses: Desktop platforms rely on fallback interface name matching with lower accuracy.
Not supported on the web platform.
data.setup_notes: Add the ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permission to your AndroidManifest.xml for Android support. No additional setup is required for iOS.
